decisions.reason: Replacing INA219 with INA3221 necessarily changes the enumerated current-monitor load powered by the normal-operation 3.3V rail.

value_updates.normal_operation_role: Primary source for the ESP32-S3, INA3221, downstream 3.3V sensors, I2C display, TTP223, and AM312 when the power board is connected

decisions.reason: The current-monitor substitution does not change USB enumeration, flashing, connector sourcing, routing, or port role.
The INA3221 substitution is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, and no additional state cleanup is required.
Changing the rail-monitor device does not alter the 5V boost converter, enable control, powered loads, or standby policy.
The monitor-device replacement does not change LED power voltage, data signaling, level shifting, or standby control.
AXP2101 remains the normal-operation power source with the same load coverage despite the current-monitor substitution.
The change does not alter the interboard connectors, pinout, board power chain, or power-distribution roles.
The current-monitor substitution does not entail any change to I2C pull-ups, series resistors, topology, speed, or cable assumptions.
The selected ESP32-S3 module and part number remain unchanged.
The current-monitor substitution does not change panel-control connectors, GPIO signals, or button placement.
No ESP32-S3 GPIO assignment is changed by selecting INA3221 instead of INA219.
The sensor-board connector-fanout role remains valid and unchanged.
